segmentName: WEX Available Product Fleet Information Data Segment
scope: Segment 148 field-level rules for WEX fuel restriction information in a Financial Transaction response

rules.title: Segment 148 sends available product and fleet information from WEX to the terminal; appears in the Financial Transaction response for WEX transactions only
Segment Type fixed 148, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Host-sourced

Segment 148 maximum length is documented as 23 characters in the opening statement but the valid-values range given is 001-999 — a numeric inconsistency; Available Product Information (Element 240) itself is 17 characters
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: 23 (opening statement) vs 001-999 (valid-values range) vs 17 (Element 240's own length) do not reconcile. Pending SME confirmation (SEG148-SME-001).

rules.title: Available Product Information (Element 240) is a fixed-format 17-character sub-structure: Restriction Code (2-3 AN, fuel product group codes 00/01/06/07/08/10/11/12/13), '=' filler, Restriction Code Amount (1-5 AN), ',' filler, Restriction Code Quantity (1-5 AN), space filler, Restriction Code Unit of Measure (1 AN)
